findings.text: approveAndCall lets any caller become the OApp delegate and mint SAND
paidCall lets any caller become the OApp delegate and mint SAND
send returns empty receipts after it burns the tokens

_credit reverts on a zero recipient or a zero amount: Code smells: `_mint` reverts when `to == address(0)` and when the amount is 0, and `_credit` has no `address(0)` to `0xdead` remap like the upstream OFT — A message with a zero recipient or a zero amount fails on every retry, so the source chain keeps the burned or locked tokens. We found no victim

The enable flag stops only send: Code smells: `_enabled` gates `send` only; `lzReceive`, `approveAndCall` and `paidCall` run when the contract is disabled — An admin who disables the contract does not stop inbound mints or the setDelegate path. We found no separate exploit.
